plugin.name: PortalValue
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Find the closest saved portal + speedwalk to your room, and catalog your portals by type.

muclient.script:
-- ── durable variable storage ──────────────────────────────────────────── -- MUSHclient keeps SetVariable data in the world's plugin-state file. That -- file is per world, and it is lost when a plugin is reinstalled by hand -- instead of reloaded - which is why settings here kept resetting. These -- wrappers keep the same SetVariable/GetVariable API but also write to -- PortalValue.dat next to the plugin, so the data survives both. -- GetPluginInfo(id, 6) is the plugin FILE path, not its folder, so the -- filename has to be stripped off. do local realGet, realSet = GetVariable, SetVariable local dir = (GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 6) or ""):match ("^(.*[\\/])") or "" local path = dir .. "PortalValue.dat" local store = {}
local function flush () local out = io.open (path, "w") if not out then return end local keys = {} for k in pairs (store) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end table.sort (keys) out:write ("-- PortalValue saved variables. Written by the plugin.\n") out:write ("return {\n") for _, k in ipairs (keys) do out:write (string.format (" [%q] = %q,\n", k, store[k])) end out:write ("}\n") out:close () end
local fh = io.open (path, "r") if fh then local body = fh:read ("*a") fh:close () local chunk = loadstring (body or "") if chunk then local ok, t = pcall (chunk) if ok and type (t) == "table" then store = t end end else -- first run: take a copy of whatever the old plugin-variable storage -- still holds, and write it out at once so it can't be lost later local ok, list = pcall (GetVariableList) if ok and type (list) == "table" then for k, v in pairs (list) do store[tostring (k)] = tostring (v) end end flush () end
function SetVariable (name, value) name, value = tostring (name), tostring (value) if store[name] ~= value then store[name] = value flush () end return realSet (name, value) -- keep the old storage in step as well end
function GetVariable (name) local v = store[tostring (name)] if v ~= nil then return v end return realGet (name) -- falls back while migrating end
function DeleteVariable (name) store[tostring (name)] = nil flush () return realSet (name, "") end end -- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
require "serialize"
local MAPPER_ID = "b6eae87ccedd84f510b74714" local GMCP_ID = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264"
-- theme colours local VERSION = "3.6" -- keep in step with the version= attribute above
local C = { hdr="@x099", val="@x045", num="@W", ok="@x048", bad="@R" }
-- colour output (fall back to plain text if the colour lib isn't available) local have_colors = pcall(require, "aardwolf_colors") function pv_echo(s) if have_colors then AnsiNote(ColoursToANSI(s)) else Note((s:gsub("@x%d%d?%d?", ""):gsub("@%a", ""))) end end local echo = pv_echo -- PortalDex code calls echo()
local function esc(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("@", "@@")) end
-- Landing-room tag for a catalogued portal: " (33994)" when the mapper has -- exactly one saved destination for that item, " (7 dests)" when it has many -- (plain chaos portals), and "" until the mapper has been cross-referenced. local function pd_room_tag(e) if e.room then return " "..C.ok.."("..tostring(e.room)..")" end if e.rooms_n and e.rooms_n > 1 then return " "..C.ok.."("..e.rooms_n.." dests)" end return "" end local function q(s) return "'" .. tostring(s):gsub("'", "''") .. "'" end
-- locate the mapper's sqlite db (adapts to whatever world/char/install we're in) local function get_db_path() if not IsPluginInstalled(MAPPER_ID) then return nil, "the Aardwolf GMCP mapper plugin is not installed" end local db_name = GetPluginVariable(MAPPER_ID, "db_name") if not db_name or db_name == "" then db_name = (WorldName() or ""):gsub("[^%w%s()_-]", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end if db_name == "" then return nil, "could not determine the mapper's database name" end local path = GetInfo(66) .. db_name .. ".db" local f = io.open(path, "rb") if not f then return nil, "database file not found at: " .. path end f:close() return path end
local CARDINALS = { n=true, s=true, e=true, w=true, u=true, d=true }
-- turn an ordered list of step commands into a compressed speedwalk + a move count local function build_speedwalk(dirs) local segs, run = {}, {} local moves = 0 local function flush() if #run > 0 then local parts = {} for _, rc in ipairs(run) do parts[#parts+1] = ((rc.c > 1) and rc.c or "") .. rc.d end segs[#segs+1] = "run " .. table.concat(parts) run = {} end end for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do moves = moves + 1 if CARDINALS[d] then local last = run[#run] if last and last.d == d then last.c = last.c + 1 else run[#run+1] = { d = d, c = 1 } end else flush() segs[#segs+1] = d end end flush() return table.concat(segs, ";"), moves end
local function recall_line(rooms, sw, msg) if rooms ~= nil then if rooms == 0 then return C.hdr .. "Recall walk : " .. C.val .. "you're standing on recall" end return C.hdr .. "Recall walk : " .. C.num .. rooms .. C.hdr .. " rooms (no portals) " .. C.ok .. (sw ~= "" and esc(sw) or "") end return C.hdr .. "Recall walk : " .. C.hdr .. "(" .. esc(msg or "unknown") .. ")" end
-- ========================================================================= -- =============== CATALOG (formerly the PortalDex plugin) =============== -- =========================================================================
-- catalog[idnumber] = { id, name, kw, ptype, restrung, leads, found, level, t, refs } catalog = catalog or {} pd_bag = pd_bag or "" -- portal container keyword if pd_auto == nil then pd_auto = true end -- catalog-as-you-go on/off scan_active = false -- a scan is running? scan_queue = scan_queue or {} pd_speed = pd_speed or 2.0 -- seconds between scan steps scan_mode = nil -- "missing" => auto-repeat scan_pass_start = 0 pd_scan_current_ref = "" -- ref being scanned right now
-- ---- catalog persistence: own file (survives reinstalls) ---- local function pd_datafile() return GetInfo(66) .. "PortalDex_data.lua" end
local function pd_save() local path = pd_datafile() local tmp = path .. ".tmp" local f = io.open(tmp, "w") if not f then return end f:write("return " .. serialize.save_simple({ catalog = catalog, bag = pd_bag, auto = pd_auto, speed = pd_speed })) f:close() os.remove(path) os.rename(tmp, path) end
local function pd_read_table(path) local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return nil end local content = f:read("*a"); f:close() if not content or content == "" then return nil end local ok, data = pcall(function() return assert(loadstring(content))() end) if ok and type(data) == "table" then return data end return nil end
local function pd_load() local data = pd_read_table(pd_datafile()) or pd_read_table(pd_datafile() .. ".tmp") if data then if type(data.catalog) == "table" then catalog = data.catalog end pd_bag = data.bag or pd_bag if data.auto ~= nil then pd_auto = data.auto end if tonumber(data.speed) then pd_speed = tonumber(data.speed) end end end
-- ---- id-box capture ---- -- We anchor on the "Keywords" line (always the first row of an Aardwolf id box) -- rather than toggling on "+----+" borders. Aardwolf prints borders all over the -- place (other id's, score, tables); an odd stray one used to desync the old -- toggle and silently drop the capture. This is immune to that. local collecting = false local buf = {}
function pd_border() -- a border while we're collecting a real record = the box just closed if collecting and #buf > 0 then pd_parse(buf); collecting = false; buf = {} end end
function pd_line(name, line, wc) local content = wc[1] if content:match("^%s*Keywords%s*:") then if collecting and #buf > 0 then pd_parse(buf) end -- flush a prior unclosed box buf = { content }; collecting = true return end if collecting then buf[#buf+1] = content end end
local function classify(kw, flagset, found) kw = (kw or ""):lower() found = (found or ""):lower() local chaos = (flagset["nosac"] and flagset["nosteal"]) or kw:find("chaos portal", 1, true) if chaos then if flagset["precious"] or kw:find("golden", 1, true) then return "golden chaos" end return "chaos" end if kw:find("trivia", 1, true) then return "trivia" end if found == "a bad trip" then return "trivia" end return "gameload" end
function pd_parse(lines) local f, cur = {}, nil for _, raw in ipairs(lines) do local label = raw:match("^%s*([%a][%a%s']-)%s*:") if label and not raw:match("^%s*:") then local val = raw:match(":%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" label = label:gsub("%s+$",""):gsub("%s+"," ") f[label] = val cur = label else local cont = raw:match("^%s*:%s*(.-)%s*$") if cont and cur then f[cur] = (f[cur] or "") .. ", " .. cont end end end
if not (f["Id"] and f["Type"]) then return end if not f["Type"]:match("[Pp]ortal") then return end if not pd_auto and not scan_active then return end
local id = (f["Id"] or ""):match("%d+") if not id then return end
local flagset = {} for w in (f["Flags"] or ""):gmatch("[%w%-]+") do flagset[w:lower()] = true end
local level = (f["Type"] or ""):match("Level%s*:%s*(%d+)") or "?" local kw = f["Keywords"] or "" local existing = catalog[id] local rec = { id = id, name = f["Name"] or "?", kw = kw, ptype = classify(kw, flagset, f["Found at"]), restrung = flagset["restrung"] and true or false, leads = f["Leads to"] or "?", found = f["Found at"] or "?", level = level, t = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), refs = (existing and existing.refs) or {}, room = existing and existing.room, roomname = existing and existing.roomname, rooms_n = existing and existing.rooms_n, } if scan_active and pd_scan_current_ref ~= "" then rec.refs[pd_scan_current_ref] = true end
local isnew = (existing == nil) catalog[id] = rec pd_save()
if isnew then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] +"..C.ok..esc(rec.ptype)..C.hdr..(rec.restrung and " "..C.val.."(restrung)" or "") .." "..C.val..esc(rec.name).." "..C.num.."("..id..")"..C.hdr.." -> "..C.val..esc(rec.leads)..pd_room_tag(rec)) end end
local pd_stamp_rooms -- forward decl; defined once cross_reference() exists
local function count_types() local counts, total, restrung = {}, 0, 0 for _, r in pairs(catalog) do counts[r.ptype] = (counts[r.ptype] or 0) + 1 total = total + 1 if r.restrung then restrung = restrung + 1 end end return counts, total, restrung end
function pd_summary() local counts, total, restrung = count_types() echo(C.hdr.."============= "..C.num.."PortalDex"..C.hdr.." =============") if total == 0 then echo(C.val.."No portals cataloged yet. 'id' a portal (or run "..C.ok.."portaldex scan"..C.val..").") return end for _, ty in ipairs({"golden chaos","chaos","trivia","gameload"}) do if counts[ty] then echo(C.hdr.." "..C.ok..string.format("%-14s", ty)..C.num..counts[ty]); counts[ty] = nil end end for ty, n in pairs(counts) do echo(C.hdr.." "..C.ok..string.format("%-14s", ty)..C.num..n) end echo(C.hdr.." "..C.val..string.format("%-14s","(restrung)")..C.num..restrung) echo(C.hdr.." "..C.val..string.format("%-14s","total")..C.num..total) echo(C.hdr.."Use "..C.ok.."portaldex list"..C.hdr.." to see them all.") end
function pd_list(name, line, wc) local filter = wc and wc[1] and wc[1]:lower() or nil -- fill in landing rooms for anything catalogued since the last cross-reference local need = false for _, r in pairs(catalog) do if r.rooms_n == nil then need = true; break end end if need then pd_stamp_rooms(true) end local arr = {} for _, r in pairs(catalog) do arr[#arr+1] = r end table.sort(arr, function(a,b) if a.ptype ~= b.ptype then return a.ptype < b.ptype end return (a.name or "") < (b.name or "") end) local shown = 0 echo(C.hdr.."============= "..C.num.."PortalDex list"..C.hdr.." =============") for _, r in ipairs(arr) do local hay = (r.ptype.." "..r.name.." "..r.leads.." "..tostring(r.room or "")):lower() if (not filter) or hay:find(filter, 1, true) then echo(C.ok..string.format("%-13s", r.ptype)..(r.restrung and C.bad.."R " or " ") ..C.val..esc(r.name).." "..C.num.."("..r.id..")"..C.hdr.." -> "..C.val..esc(r.leads)..pd_room_tag(r) ..C.hdr.." lvl "..C.num..esc(r.level)) shown = shown + 1 end end echo(C.hdr.."("..C.num..shown..C.hdr.." shown"..(filter and (", filter '"..esc(wc[1]).."'") or "")..")") end
function pd_clear() catalog = {} pd_save() echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Catalog cleared.") end
-- remove one portal from the catalog, by item id (exact) or by name text (one match) function pd_remove(name, line, wc) local arg = ((wc and wc[1]) or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","") if arg == "" then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Usage: "..C.ok.."portaldex remove <item id | name>"..C.hdr..". (ids show in "..C.ok.."portaldex list"..C.hdr..".)") return end if arg:match("^%d+$") and catalog[arg] then local nm = catalog[arg].name or "?" catalog[arg] = nil pd_save() echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Removed "..C.val..esc(nm).." "..C.num.."("..arg..")"..C.hdr.." from the catalog.") return end local low = arg:lower() local matches = {} for id, e in pairs(catalog) do local hay = ((e.name or "").." "..(e.ptype or "").." "..(e.leads or "")):lower() if hay:find(low, 1, true) then matches[#matches+1] = { id = id, e = e } end end if #matches == 0 then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] No cataloged portal matches "..C.val.."'"..esc(arg).."'"..C.hdr..".") elseif #matches == 1 then local m = matches[1] catalog[m.id] = nil pd_save() echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Removed "..C.val..esc(m.e.name or "?").." "..C.num.."("..m.id..")"..C.hdr.." from the catalog.") else echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] "..C.num..#matches..C.hdr.." matches — remove by id with "..C.ok.."portaldex remove <id>"..C.hdr..":") for _, m in ipairs(matches) do echo(" "..C.val..esc(m.e.name or "?").." "..C.num.."("..m.id..")"..C.hdr.." ["..C.ok..esc(m.e.ptype or "?")..C.hdr.."]") end end end
function pd_speed_cmd(name, line, wc) local n = tonumber(wc and wc[1]) if not n then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Scan speed: "..C.num..pd_speed..C.hdr.."s per portal. Set with "..C.ok.."portaldex speed <seconds>"..C.hdr..".") return end if n < 0.5 then n = 0.5 elseif n > 10 then n = 10 end pd_speed = n; pd_save() echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Scan speed set to "..C.num..pd_speed..C.hdr.."s per portal.") end
function pd_auto_cmd(name, line, wc) local arg = ((wc and wc[1]) or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$",""):lower() if arg == "on" then pd_auto = true elseif arg == "off" then pd_auto = false elseif arg == "" then pd_auto = not pd_auto else echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Use "..C.ok.."portaldex auto on|off"..C.hdr..".") return end pd_save() echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Catalog-as-you-go is "..(pd_auto and (C.ok.."ON") or (C.bad.."OFF")) ..C.hdr..(pd_auto and "." or " — manual id's won't be saved (scans still catalog).")) end
function pd_bag_cmd(name, line, wc) local arg = (wc and wc[1] or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","") if arg == "" then if pd_bag == "" then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] No portal container set; scans use each command's own container.") else echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Portal container keyword: "..C.val..esc(pd_bag)) end echo(C.hdr.."Set with "..C.ok.."portaldex bag <keyword>"..C.hdr..", clear with "..C.ok.."portaldex bag none"..C.hdr..".") return end if arg:lower() == "none" or arg:lower() == "clear" then pd_bag = ""; pd_save() echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Portal container cleared; scans will use each command's container.") return end pd_bag = arg; pd_save() echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Portal container set to "..C.val..esc(pd_bag)..C.hdr..". Scans will take/put using this bag.") end
-- Pull the item reference (and container) from a portal command: the LAST visible -- id number or keyword used in a take/get (dungeon portals take a first-room portal, -- nod, then take the real one). Normal portals have one take, so last == only. local function extract_ref(cmd) cmd = cmd or "" local lastref, lastcont for seg in (cmd .. ";"):gmatch("([^;]*);") do local ref, cont = seg:match("^%s*[tT]ake%s+([^%s;]+)%s+([^%s;]+)") if not ref then ref, cont = seg:match("^%s*[gG]et%s+([^%s;]+)%s+([^%s;]+)") end if not ref then ref = seg:match("^%s*[tT]ake%s+([^%s;]+)") or seg:match("^%s*[gG]et%s+([^%s;]+)") end if ref then lastref, lastcont = ref, cont end end return lastref, lastcont end
local function tcount(t) local n=0 for _ in pairs(t) do n=n+1 end return n end
local function build_ref_index() local idx = {} for id, e in pairs(catalog) do if e.refs then for r in pairs(e.refs) do idx[r] = id end end end return idx end
local function resolve_ref(ref, idx) ref = (ref or ""):lower() if ref == "" then return nil end if idx[ref] then return idx[ref] end if ref:match("^%d+$") and catalog[ref] then return ref end for id, e in pairs(catalog) do for w in (e.kw or ""):gmatch("%S+") do w = w:lower() if w == ref or (#ref < #w and w:sub(1, #ref) == ref) then return id end end end return nil end
local function make_cataloged_checker() local idx = build_ref_index() return function(ref) return resolve_ref(ref, idx) ~= nil end end
local function cross_reference() local path, why = get_db_path() if not path then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] "..esc(why or "no mapper db")..".") return nil end local ok_sql, sqlite3 = pcall(require, "sqlite3") if not ok_sql then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] sqlite3 library unavailable.") return nil end local db = sqlite3.open(path) if not db then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] could not open the mapper database.") return nil end local idx = build_ref_index() local byItem, missing, total, noitem = {}, {}, 0, 0 for row in db:nrows([[ SELECT e.dir AS cmd, e.touid AS t, r.name AS nm, r.area AS ar FROM exits e LEFT JOIN rooms r ON r.uid = e.touid WHERE e.fromuid IN ('*','**') ]]) do total = total + 1 local ref = extract_ref(row.cmd) if not ref then noitem = noitem + 1 else local entry = { ref = ref, nm = row.nm or "?", t = tostring(row.t), ar = row.ar or "?" } local id = resolve_ref(ref, idx) if not id then missing[#missing+1] = entry else byItem[id] = byItem[id] or {}; table.insert(byItem[id], entry) end end end db:close() return { byItem = byItem, missing = missing, total = total, noitem = noitem } end
-- Stamp each catalogued portal with the room it lands in, read from the mapper's -- saved portal exits (exits.touid on a '*'/'**' portal exit IS the room vnum). -- One saved destination -> that room number. A plain chaos portal saved to many -- rooms keeps a count instead, rather than a misleading single room. function pd_stamp_rooms(quiet) local x = cross_reference() if not x then return nil end local single, multi = 0, 0 for id, lst in pairs(x.byItem) do local e = catalog[id] if e then local seen, n, first = {}, 0, nil for _, ent in ipairs(lst) do local uid = ent.t if uid and uid ~= "" and uid ~= "nil" and not seen[uid] then seen[uid] = true n = n + 1 if not first then first = ent end end end if n == 1 then e.room, e.roomname = first.t, first.nm single = single + 1 else e.room, e.roomname = nil, nil if n > 1 then multi = multi + 1 end end e.rooms_n = n end end pd_save() if not quiet then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Landing rooms updated from the mapper: "..C.num..single ..C.hdr.." portal(s) with one destination, "..C.num..multi..C.hdr.." with several.") end return single end
function pd_rooms() pd_stamp_rooms(false) end
local function load_portal_refs(only_missing) local path, why = get_db_path() if not path then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] "..esc(why or "no mapper db")..".") return {} end local ok_sql, sqlite3 = pcall(require, "sqlite3") if not ok_sql then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] sqlite3 library unavailable.") return {} end local db = sqlite3.open(path) if not db then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] could not open the mapper database.") return {} end local check = only_missing and make_cataloged_checker() or nil local list, seen = {}, {} for row in db:nrows("SELECT dir FROM exits WHERE fromuid IN ('*','**')") do local ref, container = extract_ref(row.dir) local bag = (pd_bag ~= "" and pd_bag) or container if ref and bag and not seen[ref] then seen[ref] = true if (not check) or (not check(ref)) then list[#list+1] = { ref = ref, container = bag } end end end db:close() return list end
function pd_scan_finish_pass() if scan_mode == "missing" then local remaining = load_portal_refs(true) if #remaining > 0 and #remaining < scan_pass_start then scan_pass_start = #remaining scan_queue = remaining scan_active = true echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Pass done — "..C.num..#remaining..C.hdr.." still missing, retrying...") pd_scan_step() return end scan_mode = nil echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Scan complete. "..C.num..#remaining..C.hdr.." still missing" ..((#remaining > 0) and (C.hdr.." (no progress last pass — "..C.ok.."portaldex missing"..C.hdr.." to inspect)") or "")..".") else echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Scan complete.") end pd_stamp_rooms(true) pd_summary() end
function pd_scan_step() if not scan_active then return end local item = table.remove(scan_queue, 1) if not item then scan_active = false; pd_scan_finish_pass(); return end pd_scan_current_ref = (item.ref or ""):lower() Send("take " .. item.ref .. " " .. item.container) Send("id " .. item.ref) Send("put " .. item.ref .. " " .. item.container) DoAfterSpecial(pd_speed, "pd_scan_step()", 12) end
function pd_scan(name, line, wc) local arg = ((wc and wc[1]) or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$",""):lower()
if arg == "stop" then if scan_active then scan_active = false echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Scan paused — "..C.num..#scan_queue..C.hdr.." left. " ..C.ok.."portaldex scan"..C.hdr.." to resume, "..C.ok.."portaldex scan restart"..C.hdr.." to start over.") else echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] No scan running.") end return end if scan_active then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Scan already running. "..C.ok.."portaldex scan stop"..C.hdr.." to pause.") return end
if arg == "missing" then scan_queue = load_portal_refs(true) if #scan_queue == 0 then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] No missing portals to scan.") return end scan_mode = "missing"; scan_pass_start = #scan_queue echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Scanning "..C.num..#scan_queue..C.hdr.." MISSING portals (auto-repeats until done). "..C.ok.."portaldex scan stop"..C.hdr.." to pause.") scan_active = true; pd_scan_step() return end
scan_mode = nil if arg == "restart" then scan_queue = {} end
if #scan_queue > 0 then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Resuming scan — "..C.num..#scan_queue..C.hdr.." left. "..C.ok.."portaldex scan stop"..C.hdr.." to pause.") else scan_queue = load_portal_refs() if #scan_queue == 0 then echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Found no take/get portal commands in the mapper to scan.") return end echo(C.hdr.."[PortalDex] Scanning "..C.num..#scan_queue..C.hdr.." saved portals (take/id/put, ~"..pd_speed.."s each). "..C.ok.."portaldex scan stop"..C.hdr.." to pause.") end scan_active = true pd_scan_step() end
function pd_missing() local x = cross_reference() if not x then return end local present, uniq = 0, tcount(x.byItem) for _, lst in pairs(x.byItem) do present = present + #lst end table.sort(x.missing, function(a,b) return (a.ar.." "..a.nm) < (b.ar.." "..b.nm) end) echo(C.hdr.."========== "..C.num.."PortalDex vs mapper"..C.hdr.." ==========") echo(C.hdr.."Mapper portals : "..C.num..x.total) echo(C.hdr.."Matched : "..C.num..present..C.hdr.." ("..C.num..uniq..C.hdr.." unique items)") echo(C.hdr.."Missing : "..C.num..#x.missing) echo(C.hdr.."Recall/home : "..C.num..x.noitem..C.hdr.." (no take command — not bag items)") if #x.missing > 0 then echo(C.hdr.."--- missing (run "..C.ok.."portaldex scan missing"..C.hdr.." to fetch these) ---") for _, m in ipairs(x.missing) do echo(C.bad.." miss "..C.val..esc(m.nm).." "..C.num.."["..m.t.."]"..C.hdr.." ("..C.val..esc(m.ar)..C.hdr..") ref: "..C.ok..esc(m.ref)) end else echo(C.ok.."Nothing missing!") end end
-- ========================================================================= -- =================== PATHING (the original PortalValue) ================ -- =========================================================================
pv_history = pv_history or {} pv_debug = pv_debug or false
local function save_history() SetVariable("history", serialize.save_simple(pv_history)) end
-- Classify a portal command using the IN-MEMORY catalog. Returns: -- typer(cmd) -> ptype or nil ; has_chaos ; has_golden (nil if catalog empty) local function pv_portal_typer() if next(catalog) == nil then return nil end local idx = build_ref_index() local has_chaos, has_golden = false, false for _, e in pairs(catalog) do if e.ptype == "chaos" then has_chaos = true elseif e.ptype == "golden chaos" then has_golden = true end end local function lookup(cmd) -- cmd -> catalog record (or nil if uncatalogued) local ref = extract_ref(cmd) if not ref then return nil end local id = resolve_ref(ref, idx) return (id and catalog[id]) or nil end local typer = function(cmd) local r = lookup(cmd); return r and r.ptype or nil end return typer, has_chaos, has_golden, lookup end
-- Short display name for a portal on the pathing lines: its catalog item name -- with the leading article stripped, and the long chaos names collapsed. Falls -- back to the given room name when the portal isn't catalogued. local function short_portal_name(rec, roomname) if not rec then return roomname or "?" end if rec.ptype == "chaos" then return "chaos portal" end if rec.ptype == "golden chaos" then return "golden chaos portal" end local nm = (rec.name or roomname or "?") nm = nm:gsub("^%s*[Aa]n?%s+", ""):gsub("^%s*[Tt]he%s+", "") return nm end

"This room : " .. C.val .. esc(r.newname) .. " " .. C.num .. "[" .. esc(r.newuid) .. "] " .. C.hdr .. "(" .. C.val .. esc(r.area) .. C.hdr .. ")") local areanote = "" if r.same_area == false then areanote = C.hdr .. " (in " .. C.val .. esc(r.parea or "?") .. C.hdr .. ")" end pv_echo(C.hdr .. "From portal : " .. C.val .. esc(r.pname) .. " " .. C.num .. "[" .. esc(r.puid) .. "]" .. areanote) pv_echo(C.hdr .. " command : " .. C.ok .. esc(r.pcmd) .. " " .. C.hdr .. "(lvl " .. C.num .. esc(r.plevel) .. C.hdr .. ")") pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Speedwalk : " .. C.ok .. (r.sw ~= "" and esc(r.sw) or "(adjacent)")) pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Movements : " .. C.num .. r.moves .. C.hdr .. " walk + " .. C.num .. "1" .. C.hdr .. " portal = " .. C.num .. (r.moves + 1)) if not r.has_chaos then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "No normals : " .. C.bad .. "need to run portaldex scan") elseif r.nn_moves then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "No normals : " .. C.num .. r.nn_moves .. C.hdr .. " walk + " .. C.num .. "1" .. C.hdr .. " portal = " .. C.num .. (r.nn_moves + 1) .. C.hdr .. " from " .. C.val .. esc(r.nn_pname or "?") .. " " .. C.num .. "[" .. esc(r.nn_puid or "?") .. "]") else pv_echo(C.hdr .. "No normals : " .. C.val .. "(none reachable)") end if not (r.has_chaos and r.has_golden) then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "No chaos : " .. C.bad .. "need to run portaldex scan") elseif r.nc_moves then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "No chaos : " .. C.num .. r.nc_moves .. C.hdr .. " walk + " .. C.num .. "1" .. C.hdr .. " portal = " .. C.num .. (r.nc_moves + 1) .. C.hdr .. " from " .. C.val .. esc(r.nc_pname or "?") .. " " .. C.num .. "[" .. esc(r.nc_puid or "?") .. "]") else pv_echo(C.hdr .. "No chaos : " .. C.val .. "(none reachable)") end if not r.has_catalog then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Gameload : " .. C.bad .. "need to run portaldex scan") elseif r.gl_moves then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Gameload : " .. C.num .. r.gl_moves .. C.hdr .. " walk + " .. C.num .. "1" .. C.hdr .. " portal = " .. C.num .. (r.gl_moves + 1) .. C.hdr .. " from " .. C.val .. esc(r.gl_pname or "?") .. " " .. C.num .. "[" .. esc(r.gl_puid or "?") .. "]") else pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Gameload : " .. C.val .. "(none reachable)") end pv_echo(recall_line(r.recall_rooms, r.recall_sw, r.recall_msg)) pv_worth_lines(r) if r.have_here then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "PS : " .. C.val .. "You already have a portal here!") end end
-- ===== "is this room worth a portal?" ================================== -- Answers, from your OWN data: if you put a portal in this room, how much -- walking would it save you across the mobs you actually kill, and how does -- that compare with the portals you already carry? -- -- Kill weights come from Search_and_Destroy's SnDdb.db when it is present -- (every mob row there carries a kill_count). Without SnD we weight every -- mapped room equally, which still answers "how much walking would a portal -- here save" -- just spread over the whole map instead of over your targets. -- -- Everything is measured against the portals YOU have and the mobs YOU kill, -- so there are no baked-in numbers: the "good portal" bar is the median value -- of your own portals.
local PW = { built = false }
local function pw_snd_path() for _, p in ipairs{ GetInfo(66) .. "SnDdb.db", GetInfo(66) .. "/SnDdb.db" } do local f = io.open(p, "rb") if f then f:close(); return p end end return nil end
local function pw_comma(n) local s = tostring(math.floor(tonumber(n) or 0)) local out = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse() return (out:gsub("^,", "")) end
-- Build the once-per-session model: nearest and second-nearest portal for every -- mapped room, plus how much walking each portal you own is uniquely saving. local function pw_build(dbpath) local ok_sql, sqlite3 = pcall(require, "sqlite3") if not ok_sql then return nil, "sqlite3 library unavailable" end local db = sqlite3.open(dbpath) if not db then return nil, "could not open the mapper database" end
local fadj, area_of = {}, {} for row in db:nrows("SELECT uid, area FROM rooms") do area_of[tostring(row.uid)] = row.area or "?" end for row in db:nrows("SELECT fromuid AS f, touid AS t FROM exits WHERE fromuid NOT IN ('*','**')") do local f = tostring(row.f) local b = fadj[f]; if not b then b = {}; fadj[f] = b end b[#b+1] = tostring(row.t) end
-- every room a portal can drop you into local seeds, seen = {}, {} for row in db:nrows("SELECT touid AS t FROM exits WHERE fromuid IN ('*','**')") do local uid = tostring(row.t) if not seen[uid] then seen[uid] = true; seeds[#seeds+1] = uid end end db:close() if next(seen) == nil then return nil, "no portals saved in the mapper yet" end
-- nearest-portal BFS from every portal landing at once (unit edges, so a -- plain FIFO queue keeps distances in order; no heap needed) local d1 = {} local q, head = {}, 1 for _, s in ipairs(seeds) do if d1[s] == nil then d1[s] = 0; q[#q+1] = s end end while head <= #q do local u = q[head]; head = head + 1 local nb, d = fadj[u], d1[u] if nb then for i = 1, #nb do local v = nb[i] if d1[v] == nil then d1[v] = d + 1; q[#q+1] = v end end end end
-- weights: kills per room if SnD is installed, otherwise every room counts 1 local kills, weighted = {}, false local sp = pw_snd_path() if sp then local sdb = sqlite3.open(sp) if sdb then local okq = pcall(function() for row in sdb:nrows("SELECT roomid AS r, SUM(kill_count) AS k FROM mobs WHERE kill_count>0 GROUP BY roomid") do kills[tostring(row.r)] = tonumber(row.k) or 0 weighted = true end end) if not okq then kills, weighted = {}, false end sdb:close() end end if not weighted then kills = {} for u in pairs(d1) do kills[u] = 1 end end
-- Everything below is PER AREA: a portal competes with the other portals -- that cover the same area, not with the whole collection. local kills_by_area = {} -- area -> { room = weight } local total_by_area = {} -- area -> steps currently walked there local weight_by_area = {} -- area -> total kill weight there local worst_by_area = {} -- area -> longest walk to any killed room there for r, k in pairs(kills) do local a = d1[r] if a then local ar = area_of[r] or "?" local kb = kills_by_area[ar]; if not kb then kb = {}; kills_by_area[ar] = kb end kb[r] = k total_by_area[ar] = (total_by_area[ar] or 0) + k * a weight_by_area[ar] = (weight_by_area[ar] or 0) + k if a > (worst_by_area[ar] or -1) then worst_by_area[ar] = a end end end
local nport = 0 for _ in pairs(seen) do nport = nport + 1 end
return { built = true, fadj = fadj, d1 = d1, kills = kills, area_of = area_of, kills_by_area = kills_by_area, total_by_area = total_by_area, weight_by_area = weight_by_area, worst_by_area = worst_by_area, nport = nport, weighted = weighted } end
local function pw_model(dbpath) if PW.built then return PW end local t0 = os.clock() local m, why = pw_build(dbpath) if not m then return nil, why end PW = m if pv_debug then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] worth model built in " .. C.num .. string.format("%.2f", os.clock() - t0) .. C.hdr .. "s over " .. C.num .. m.nport .. C.hdr .. " portals.") end return PW end
-- How much walking a portal landing in room T would save inside T's OWN area, -- and where that puts it among the portals already covering that area. local function pw_evaluate(T, area, dbpath) local m, why = pw_model(dbpath) if not m then return nil, why end area = area or m.area_of[T] or "?"
local targets = m.kills_by_area[area] if not targets then return { area = area, save = 0, pct = 0, weighted = m.weighted, verdict = "nodata" } end
local dT, q, head = { [T] = 0 }, { T }, 1 while head <= #q do local u = q[head]; head = head + 1 local nb = m.fadj[u] if nb then for i = 1, #nb do local v = nb[i] if dT[v] == nil then dT[v] = dT[u] + 1; q[#q+1] = v end end end end
-- Average is not enough on its own: a room can rack up a big total and still -- leave the far end of the area untouched. Track the worst remaining walk too, -- which is what separates a junction serving the whole area from a spot that -- only shortens the half you were already close to. local save, new_sum, new_worst = 0, 0, 0 for r, k in pairs(targets) do local a, b = m.d1[r], dT[r] local best = a if a and b and b < a then save = save + k * (a - b); best = b end if best then new_sum = new_sum + k * best if best > new_worst then new_worst = best end end end
local tot = m.total_by_area[area] or 0 local wsum = m.weight_by_area[area] or 0 local worst = m.worst_by_area[area] or 0 local pct = (tot > 0) and (100 * save / tot) or 0 local tailpct = (worst > 0) and (100 * (worst - new_worst) / worst) or 0 local cur_avg = (wsum > 0) and (tot / wsum) or 0 local new_avg = (wsum > 0) and (new_sum / wsum) or 0 -- weighted toward the average, because that is most of the walking, but with -- enough of the tail to prefer a junction that also reaches the far rooms local score = 0.75 * pct + 0.25 * tailpct
-- Two gates, because neither alone is honest. The percentage is how much of -- your walking IN THIS AREA a portal here would cut, which is the thing you -- actually feel. The pool median stops a well covered area from rewarding -- yet another portal -- but only once the pool is big enough for a median to -- mean anything; with two portals, "beats the median" just means "beats the -- worse of the two", which would wave almost anything through. local verdict if save <= 0 then verdict = "none" elseif score >= 15 then verdict = "good" elseif score >= 5 then verdict = "ok" else verdict = "poor" end
return { area = area, save = save, pct = pct, score = score, tailpct = tailpct, cur_avg = cur_avg, new_avg = new_avg, cur_worst = worst, new_worst = new_worst, weighted = m.weighted, verdict = verdict } end
function pv_worth_lines(r) if r.w_msg then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Worth it : " .. C.bad .. esc(r.w_msg)) return end if not r.w_verdict then return end if r.w_verdict == "nodata" then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Worth it : " .. C.val .. "no kills recorded in " .. C.val .. esc(r.w_area or "?") .. C.hdr .. " yet, so there is nothing to weigh a portal against.") return end
local tag if r.w_verdict == "good" then tag = C.ok .. "This room would make a good portal for you." elseif r.w_verdict == "ok" then tag = C.val .. "Some help, but not a lot; worth a slot only if you come here often." elseif r.w_verdict == "poor" then tag = C.bad .. "Not worth a portal slot." else tag = C.bad .. "Saves you nothing here; you can already get to these mobs as fast." end
pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Worth it : " .. C.val .. esc(r.w_area or "?") .. C.hdr .. " mobs: avg walk " .. C.num .. string.format("%.1f", r.w_cur_avg or 0) .. C.hdr .. " -> " .. C.num .. string.format("%.1f", r.w_new_avg or 0) .. C.hdr .. ", worst " .. C.num .. (r.w_cur_worst or 0) .. C.hdr .. " -> " .. C.num .. (r.w_new_worst or 0)) pv_echo(C.hdr .. " " .. C.num .. pw_comma(r.w_save) .. C.hdr .. " steps saved (" .. C.num .. string.format("%.0f", r.w_pct or 0) .. "%" .. C.hdr .. " less walking, " .. C.num .. string.format("%.0f", r.w_tailpct or 0) .. "%" .. C.hdr .. " off the far end)" .. (r.w_weighted and "" or (C.hdr .. " (no SnD kill data: map-wide estimate)"))) pv_echo(C.hdr .. " " .. tag) end
function pv_reload() -- ReloadPlugin tears down this script space, so a timer scheduled here dies -- with it. Bounce the call through the WORLD's script space instead. pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] Reloading v" .. VERSION .. "...") local Q = string.char(39) -- a single quote, built rather than escaped Execute(GetAlphaOption("script_prefix") .. 'DoAfterSpecial(1, "ReloadPlugin(' .. Q .. GetPluginID() .. Q .. ')", sendto.script)') end
function pv_worth_refresh() PW = { built = false } pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] Portal-worth model cleared; it rebuilds on your next " .. C.ok .. "pv" .. C.hdr .. ".") end
local function compute_for_room(T, channel) T = tostring(T)
local dbpath, why = get_db_path() if not dbpath then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] " .. esc(why or "could not locate the mapper database") .. ". Type " .. C.ok .. "pvcheck" .. C.hdr .. " for details.") return end local ok_sql, sqlite3 = pcall(require, "sqlite3") if not ok_sql then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] sqlite3 library unavailable.") return end local db = sqlite3.open(dbpath) if not db then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] Could not open the mapper database.") return end
local area, tname for row in db:nrows(string.format("SELECT area, name FROM rooms WHERE uid=%s", q(T))) do area = row.area; tname = row.name end if not area then db:close() pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] Landing room " .. C.num .. esc(T) .. C.hdr .. " isn't mapped yet, so I can't compute a path.") return end
local have_portal_here = false for _ in db:nrows(string.format( "SELECT 1 AS x FROM exits WHERE fromuid IN ('*','**') AND touid=%s LIMIT 1", q(T))) do have_portal_here = true end
local radj = {} for row in db:nrows("SELECT fromuid AS f, touid AS t, dir AS d FROM exits WHERE fromuid NOT IN ('*','**')") do local t = tostring(row.t) local bucket = radj[t] if not bucket then bucket = {}; radj[t] = bucket end bucket[#bucket+1] = { from = tostring(row.f), dir = row.d } end
local portals = {} for row in db:nrows([[ SELECT e.touid AS t, e.dir AS d, e.level AS lv, r.name AS nm, r.area AS ar FROM exits e JOIN rooms r ON r.uid = e.touid WHERE e.fromuid IN ('*','**') ]]) do portals[#portals+1] = { uid = tostring(row.t), cmd = row.d, level = row.lv, name = row.nm, area = row.ar } end
local recall_uid for row in db:nrows("SELECT touid AS t, dir AS d FROM exits WHERE fromuid='**'") do if not recall_uid then recall_uid = tostring(row.t) end if row.d and tostring(row.d):lower():find("recall") then recall_uid = tostring(row.t); break end end db:close()
local dist = { [T] = 0 } local fwd = {} local queue, head = { T }, 1 while head <= #queue do local cur = queue[head]; head = head + 1 local d0 = dist[cur] local preds = radj[cur] if preds then for _, pe in ipairs(preds) do local p = pe.from if dist[p] == nil then dist[p] = d0 + 1 fwd[p] = { dir = pe.dir, nxt = cur } queue[#queue+1] = p end end end end
local function path_dirs(start) local dirs, node = {}, start while node ~= T do local step = fwd[node] if not step then return nil end dirs[#dirs+1] = step.dir node = step.nxt end return dirs end
local recall_rooms, recall_sw, recall_msg if not recall_uid then recall_msg = "no 'recall' portal saved in the mapper" elseif recall_uid == T then recall_rooms, recall_sw = 0, "" elseif dist[recall_uid] == nil then recall_msg = "no known no-portal walk from recall yet" else recall_sw, recall_rooms = build_speedwalk(path_dirs(recall_uid)) end
local typer, has_chaos, has_golden, lookup = pv_portal_typer() local function pname_of(pt) -- portal item name (shortened) or fallback room name return short_portal_name(lookup and lookup(pt.cmd) or nil, pt.name) end local best, best_nn, best_noch, best_gl for _, pt in ipairs(portals) do if pt.uid ~= T and dist[pt.uid] ~= nil then local d = dist[pt.uid] if (not best) or d < best.d or (d == best.d and pt.area == area and best.portal.area ~= area) then best = { d = d, portal = pt } end local ty = typer and typer(pt.cmd) or nil if ty ~= "chaos" then if (not best_nn) or d < best_nn.d or (d == best_nn.d and pt.area == area and best_nn.portal.area ~= area) then best_nn = { d = d, portal = pt } end end if ty ~= "chaos" and ty ~= "golden chaos" then if (not best_noch) or d < best_noch.d or (d == best_noch.d and pt.area == area and best_noch.portal.area ~= area) then best_noch = { d = d, portal = pt } end end if ty == "gameload" then -- gameload only: no chaos/golden/trivia/uncatalogued if (not best_gl) or d < best_gl.d or (d == best_gl.d and pt.area == area and best_gl.portal.area ~= area) then best_gl = { d = d, portal = pt } end end end end
if not best then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] No saved portal has a known walking path to " .. C.val .. esc(tname or "?") .. " " .. C.num .. "[" .. esc(T) .. "]" .. C.hdr .. " yet. (Explore the connecting rooms, or save a nearby portal.)") pv_echo(recall_line(recall_rooms, recall_sw, recall_msg)) if have_portal_here then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "PS : " .. C.val .. "You already have a portal here!") end return end
local sw, walkmoves = build_speedwalk(path_dirs(best.portal.uid))
local nn_moves, nn_pname, nn_puid if best_nn then _, nn_moves = build_speedwalk(path_dirs(best_nn.portal.uid)) nn_pname = pname_of(best_nn.portal); nn_puid = best_nn.portal.uid end local nc_moves, nc_pname, nc_puid if best_noch then _, nc_moves = build_speedwalk(path_dirs(best_noch.portal.uid)) nc_pname = pname_of(best_noch.portal); nc_puid = best_noch.portal.uid end local gl_moves, gl_pname, gl_puid if best_gl then _, gl_moves = build_speedwalk(path_dirs(best_gl.portal.uid)) gl_pname = pname_of(best_gl.portal); gl_puid = best_gl.portal.uid end
local rec = { time = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), area = area, newname = tname or "?", newuid = T, pname = pname_of(best.portal), puid = best.portal.uid, parea = best.portal.area or "?", same_area = (best.portal.area == area), pcmd = best.portal.cmd or "?", plevel = tostring(best.portal.level or 0), sw = sw, moves = walkmoves, recall_rooms = recall_rooms, recall_sw = recall_sw, recall_msg = recall_msg, have_here = have_portal_here, has_chaos = has_chaos or false, has_golden = has_golden or false, has_catalog = (typer ~= nil), nn_moves = nn_moves, nn_pname = nn_pname, nn_puid = nn_puid, nc_moves = nc_moves, nc_pname = nc_pname, nc_puid = nc_puid, gl_moves = gl_moves, gl_pname = gl_pname, gl_puid = gl_puid, } local wv, wwhy = pw_evaluate(T, area, dbpath) if wv then rec.w_save, rec.w_pct, rec.w_tailpct = wv.save, wv.pct, wv.tailpct rec.w_cur_avg, rec.w_new_avg = wv.cur_avg, wv.new_avg rec.w_cur_worst, rec.w_new_worst = wv.cur_worst, wv.new_worst rec.w_verdict, rec.w_weighted, rec.w_area = wv.verdict, wv.weighted, wv.area else rec.w_msg = wwhy end
table.insert(pv_history, rec) save_history()
if channel then local recall_disp = (recall_rooms ~= nil) and tostring(recall_rooms) or "N/A" local nn_disp = (has_chaos and nn_moves) and tostring(nn_moves + 1) or "N/A" local nc_disp = (has_chaos and has_golden and nc_moves) and tostring(nc_moves + 1) or "N/A" local gl_disp = (typer and gl_moves) and tostring(gl_moves + 1) or "N/A" local summary = C.val .. esc(area) .. " " .. esc(tname or "?") .. C.hdr .. " (" .. C.num .. T .. C.hdr .. "): [" .. C.num .. (walkmoves + 1) .. C.hdr .. " movements from " .. C.val .. esc(best.portal.area or "?") .. " " .. esc(pname_of(best.portal)) .. C.hdr .. " (" .. C.num .. best.portal.uid .. C.hdr .. ")] [" .. C.num .. nn_disp .. C.hdr .. " no normals] [" .. C.num .. nc_disp .. C.hdr .. " no chaos] [" .. C.num .. gl_disp .. C.hdr .. " gameload] [" .. C.num .. recall_disp .. C.hdr .. " portaless movements from recall" .. C.hdr .. "]" Send(channel .. " " .. summary) pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] Sent summary to " .. C.val .. esc(channel) .. C.hdr .. "." .. (have_portal_here and (C.hdr .. " (You already have a portal here!)") or "")) return end
pv_show_record(rec, true) end
local function process_current_room(channel) local _, data = CallPlugin(GMCP_ID, "gmcpval", "room.info") local room pcall(function() room = assert(loadstring("return " .. (data or "nil")))() end) if type(room) ~= "table" or not room.num then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] Couldn't read the current room from GMCP (try LOOK first).") return end compute_for_room(tostring(room.num), channel) end
-- ===== pathing alias entry points =====
function pv_test() process_current_room() end
function pv_channel(name, line, wc) local channel = (wc[1] or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if channel == "" then process_current_room() else process_current_room(channel) end end
function pv_show_history() if #pv_history == 0 then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] History is empty.") return end pv_echo(C.hdr .. "========= " .. C.num .. "PortalValue history (" .. #pv_history .. ")" .. C.hdr .. " =========") for i, r in ipairs(pv_history) do local pnote = (r.same_area == false) and (C.hdr .. " (in " .. C.val .. esc(r.parea or "?") .. C.hdr .. ")") or "" local rnote = r.recall_rooms and (C.hdr .. " recall " .. C.num .. r.recall_rooms .. C.hdr .. "r") or "" pv_echo(C.hdr .. string.format("%2d. ", i) .. C.val .. esc(r.newname) .. " " .. C.num .. "[" .. esc(r.newuid) .. "] " .. C.hdr .. "<- " .. C.val .. esc(r.pname) .. " " .. C.num .. "[" .. esc(r.puid) .. "]" .. pnote) pv_echo(" " .. C.ok .. (r.sw ~= "" and esc(r.sw) or "(adjacent)") .. C.hdr .. " (" .. C.num .. r.moves .. "+1" .. C.hdr .. " moves, " .. C.val .. esc(r.area) .. C.hdr .. ", " .. esc(r.time) .. ")" .. rnote) end end
function pv_purge() pv_history = {} save_history() pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] History cleared.") end
function pv_toggle_debug() pv_debug = not pv_debug pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] Debug " .. C.num .. (pv_debug and "ON" or "OFF") .. C.hdr .. ".") end
function pv_check() pv_echo(C.hdr .. "=================== " .. C.num .. "PortalValue check" .. C.hdr .. " ===================") local has_mapper = IsPluginInstalled(MAPPER_ID) pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Mapper plugin : " .. (has_mapper and (C.ok .. "found") or (C.bad .. "NOT installed"))) local has_gmcp = IsPluginInstalled(GMCP_ID) pv_echo(C.hdr .. "GMCP handler : " .. (has_gmcp and (C.ok .. "found") or (C.bad .. "NOT installed"))) local path, why = get_db_path() if not path then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Database : " .. C.bad .. esc(why or "not found")) pv_echo(C.bad .. "Not ready. Make sure the Aardwolf mapper is installed and you have") pv_echo(C.bad .. "looked at a room at least once so the mapper has built its database.") return end pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Database : " .. C.ok .. esc(path)) local ok_sql, sqlite3 = pcall(require, "sqlite3") if not ok_sql then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "SQLite : " .. C.bad .. "library unavailable") return end local db = sqlite3.open(path) if not db then pv_echo(C.hdr .. "SQLite : " .. C.bad .. "could not open the database") return end local nrooms, nportals = 0, 0 for row in db:nrows("SELECT count(*) AS c FROM rooms") do nrooms = row.c end for row in db:nrows("SELECT count(*) AS c FROM exits WHERE fromuid IN ('*','**')") do nportals = row.c end db:close() local _, ncat = count_types() pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Rooms mapped : " .. C.num .. nrooms) pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Saved portals : " .. C.num .. nportals) pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Catalogued : " .. C.num .. ncat) if nportals == 0 then pv_echo(C.ok .. "Ready, " .. C.hdr .. "but you have no saved mapper portals yet (add with 'mapper portal <command>').") else pv_echo(C.ok .. "Ready. Stand in a room and type " .. C.val .. "pv" .. C.ok .. ".") end end
-- combined help (both "portalvalue help" and "portaldex help" land here) function pv_help_all() pv_echo(C.hdr .. "=================== " .. C.num .. "PortalValue " .. C.val .. VERSION .. C.hdr .. " ===================") pv_echo(C.val .. "Find the nearest portal to walk from, and catalog your portals by type.") pv_echo(C.hdr .. "-- pathing --") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " pv " .. C.val .. "- nearest portal + speedwalk to your room") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " pv <channel> " .. C.val .. "- post a one-line summary to a channel (e.g. pv spo)") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portalvaluehistory " .. C.val .. "- list past results") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portalvaluepurge " .. C.val .. "- clear history") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " pvcheck " .. C.val .. "- verify mapper / database setup") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " pvreload " .. C.val .. "- reload the plugin after an edit") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " pvworth " .. C.val .. "- rebuild the \"worth it\" model (after buying/selling portals)") pv_echo(C.hdr .. "-- catalog --") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portaldex " .. C.val .. "- catalog summary (counts by type)") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portaldex list [t] " .. C.val .. "- list catalogued portals (optional filter)") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portaldex scan " .. C.val .. "- id saved portals (also: scan stop/restart/missing)") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portaldex missing " .. C.val .. "- mapper portals not yet catalogued") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portaldex rooms " .. C.val .. "- refresh landing room numbers from the mapper") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portaldex bag <kw> " .. C.val .. "- set portal container keyword (used by scan)") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portaldex auto on|off " .. C.val .. "- catalog-as-you-go toggle") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portaldex speed <s> " .. C.val .. "- scan pacing (seconds per portal)") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portaldex remove <id|name> " .. C.val .. "- remove one portal from the catalog") pv_echo(C.hdr .. " portaldex clear " .. C.val .. "- wipe the catalog") pv_echo(C.hdr .. "Portals also catalog automatically whenever you " .. C.ok .. "id" .. C.hdr .. " one.") pv_echo(C.bad .. "Scan uses the LAST item id/keyword in each mapper portal command.") end
-- ===== lifecycle (does both halves) =====
function OnPluginInstall() -- catalog (own file) + one-time migration from the old PortalDex plugin variable pd_load() if next(catalog) == nil then local saved = GetVariable("catalog") if saved and saved ~= "" then local ok, t = pcall(function() return assert(loadstring("return "..saved))() end) if ok and type(t) == "table" then catalog = t; pd_save() end end end -- pv history (plugin state) local saved = GetVariable("history") if saved and saved ~= "" then local ok, t = pcall(function() return assert(loadstring("return " .. saved))() end) pv_history = (ok and type(t) == "table") and t or {} else pv_history = {} end local _, total = count_types() pv_echo(C.hdr .. "[PortalValue] Loaded v" .. VERSION .. ". " .. C.num .. #pv_history .. C.hdr .. " result(s), " .. C.num .. total .. C.hdr .. " portal(s) cataloged (" .. (pd_auto and (C.ok .. "auto ON") or (C.bad .. "auto OFF")) .. C.hdr .. "). Type " .. C.ok .. "portalvalue help" .. C.hdr .. ".") DoAfterSpecial(2, "pv_check()", 12) end
function OnPluginSaveState() pd_save() save_history() end
